verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's own GitHub integration provides event-triggered agent work: automated PR reviews, automated issue triage, and @gemini-cli mentions for task delegation, which covers trigger-based maintenance. A community user corroborates the automated code reviews. Recurring schedules are not documented, and non-interactive script mode is only a building block for scheduling. Missing for 10: documented cron/recurring schedule support, evidence of autonomous fix-and-commit loops (not just review/triage), always-on agent hosting.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
Issue Triage: Automated labeling and prioritization of GitHub issues based on content analysis
Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
Gemini is consistently offering better code review tips. It has officially caught multiple potential bugs
